definition: a high nest or dwelling
example: The eagle returned to its aerie on the cliff.

definition: concerned with beauty or artistic appreciation
example: The building had strong aesthetic appeal.

definition: artificial and designed to impress
example: His affected manner irritated the staff.

definition: to make suffering or a problem less severe
example: The new drug alleviated her chronic pain.

definition: to combine or unite to form one structure
example: The two firms amalgamated into one.

definition: open to more than one interpretation
example: The ambiguous clause led to a lawsuit.

definition: to gradually write off the cost or value of something
example: They amortized the loan over thirty years.

definition: an ornament worn as a charm against evil
example: She wore an amulet around her neck.

definition: a thing belonging to a period other than its own
example: The phone in the film was an anachronism.

definition: the absence of pain sensation
example: The drug produced complete analgesia.

definition: comparable in certain respects; similar
example: Her situation was analogous to mine.

definition: not likely to provoke dissent or offense; bland
example: The speech was deliberately anodyne.

definition: to cause someone to become hostile
example: He antagonized the staff with constant criticism.

definition: a person who renounces a belief or principle
example: He was branded an apostate by his former allies.

definition: based on random choice rather than reason
example: The decision seemed arbitrary and unfair.

definition: to act as a judge or mediator in a dispute
example: She was asked to arbitrate the labor dispute.

definition: to make a concerted attack on
example: Critics assailed the new policy.

definition: a sign of what will happen in the future; an omen
example: The birds were seen as augury of war.

definition: severe or strict in manner or appearance
example: The room was bare and austere.

definition: to divide into two branches or forks
example: The road bifurcates just past the river.

definition: showing a casual and cheerful indifference
example: Her blithe attitude annoyed the worried planners.

definition: to support or strengthen
example: New evidence bolstered his case.

definition: a secret political clique or faction
example: A small cabal controlled the party.

definition: an unfounded or false story or claim
example: The rumor turned out to be a canard.

definition: truthful and straightforward; frank
example: She gave a candid assessment of the risks.
